name: Fix in Scanopy
description: A credential or a scan setting has to change. The next scan reads what this one could not.

name: Check the device
description: The device answered, but served less than it says it holds. Nothing in Scanopy changes that — the agent's SNMP view or VLAN context has to.

name: Should clear on the next full scan
description: A read stopped before it finished. Previously discovered values were kept, and a complete scan should replace these.

name: Nothing to do
description: True of the device, or of the data it returned. Rescanning will not change it.
